instagram.title: 10 settings, *10 minutes*, no expert needed
instagram.get: every switch, and what it does

instagram.title: Choose the right plan
instagram.what: ChatGPT: Business, Enterprise, Edu and API are not trained on by default
instagram.bestFor: Team, Enterprise and API are not trained on by default
instagram.meta: Personal plans: your own settings decide

instagram.title: Turn off training
instagram.what: ChatGPT: Settings > Data controls > Improve the model for everyone: off
instagram.bestFor: Settings > Privacy > Help improve our AI models: off
instagram.meta: New chats stop training. Your history stays.

instagram.title: Skip chat feedback
instagram.what: ChatGPT: a thumbs up/down can put the whole chat in training, even opted out
instagram.bestFor: a thumbs up/down stores the whole chat for up to 5 years
instagram.meta: Skip the thumbs on anything sensitive

instagram.title: Keep chats private
instagram.what: ChatGPT: ••• > Lock chat hides a chat behind a 4-digit PIN (rolling out)
instagram.bestFor: delete a chat: gone from history now, from servers within 30 days
instagram.meta: A locked chat is hidden, not encrypted

instagram.title: Use temporary chat
instagram.what: ChatGPT: new chat > Temporary. No history, no new memories, no training
instagram.bestFor: ghost icon (top right) starts an incognito chat. Same rules.
instagram.meta: Both may keep a copy up to 30 days for safety

instagram.title: Turn off memory
instagram.bestFor: Settings > Your Claude > Memory from chats: pause or reset
instagram.meta: Deleting a chat may not delete its memories

instagram.title: Delete old shared links
instagram.what: ChatGPT: Settings > Data controls > Shared links > Manage
instagram.bestFor: Settings > Privacy > Shared chats > Manage > Unshare
instagram.meta: Anyone with a link can read that chat

instagram.title: Check your Codex settings
instagram.what: Codex: Codex settings > Include environments, a separate training switch
instagram.bestFor: follows your Claude training setting; /feedback kept 5 years
instagram.meta: Opting out in ChatGPT doesn't change Codex's

instagram.title: Audit your extensions
instagram.what: ChatGPT: Settings > Plugins > app > Disconnect what you don't use
instagram.meta: Connect only services you trust and need

instagram.title: Protect real secrets
instagram.what: Never paste passwords, API keys, card or bank numbers, health records
instagram.bestFor: keys go in an encrypted secret, never in code or chats
instagram.meta: Leaked a key? Rotate it right away.

instagram.sub: Don't wait for a data leak.
bullets: Open Settings in ChatGPT and Claude
